subject: Hard coded column numbers in generated code

messages.author: 3bd94f65c4684bac
messages.subject: Hard coded column numbers in generated code
parts:
Hi Graham

I have noticed that the generated scripts reference hard-coded column
numbers when building models and graphs. What would you think of
having the generated code be driven off crs$input? This would allow
the script to be changed in one place only...

# example code generated random_forest.R line 200:
crs$rf <- randomForest(RainTomorrow ~ .,
data=crs$dataset[crs$sample,c(3:22, 24)],
ntree=500,
mtry=4,
importance=TRUE,
na.action=na.roughfix,
replace=FALSE)

# a possible alternative
crs$rf <- randomForest(RainTomorrow ~ .,
data=crs$dataset[crs$sample,c(crs$input,crs$target)],
ntree=500,
mtry=4,
importance=TRUE,
na.action=na.roughfix,
replace=FALSE)

If you think this is a good idea I'm happy to pull together a patch.

Shane
